title: 4.10 My Day Mission
unit_outcome: Locate familiar things and describe a short supported routine using known subjects, simple present chunks, days, and clock times.
goal: Build and tell one supported day from a coherent home-and-routine timeline while also locating one familiar object.
grammar_function: Integrated room/object location, there is/are, simple-present routine, First/Then, day, and whole-hour time.
speaking_outcome: Deliver six model-supported mission utterances covering home/location, time, and a four-step daily sequence.
